description.narrative: Goal: "Local communities understand and can promote the implementation of policies through the participation of communities/farmers, supported by information through dialogue and exchange, cooperation from relevant sectors, and can adapt appropriately to climate change" in line with the Lao PDR government's Green and Sustainable Development Strategy. Objectives: - To build understanding and capacity regarding the promotion of CSA policy implementation / the Green and Sustainable Development Strategy for relevant local stakeholders in 4 target districts, and to foster the participation of communities, farmers, and local stakeholders in supporting the implementation of relevant policies for adapting to climate change. - To create participation and cooperation with relevant local stakeholders in a systematic manner, while also establishing an enabling environment for promoting the implementation of relevant policies at the local level through forums/workshops for exchange, learning, and systematic lesson-learning. Outcomes: 1. Government partners and relevant local stakeholders in the 4 target districts are able to effectively promote the implementation of CSA policy and related policies to communities/farmers and other stakeholders. Communities, farmers, and relevant stakeholders have a deep understanding of the Green and Sustainable Development policies/strategies including related policies. Communities/farmers can access policies, participate in promoting policy implementation, and can adapt appropriately to climate change according to their specific contexts. 2. Government partners at the local level in the 4 target districts and relevant stakeholders have the understanding and capacity to broadly promote the implementation of CSA policy and related policies locally, and can participate appropriately and effectively with communities/farmers, investors, and various local stakeholders. There is systematic cooperation among local stakeholders, communities, farmers, and entrepreneurs. All sectors cooperate and participate in promoting policy implementation, and take ownership of implementing green development policies sustainably through dialogue platforms, exchange and learning workshops, and systematic lesson-learning.

participating-org.narrative:
Huam Jai Asasamak Association (“United in Volunteering”, or HJA) is a Lao Civil Society Organization, formed following a research project commissioned by the Canadian organization CUSO in 2003. In 2007 HJA established the Lao PDR’s first national youth volunteering programme, focusing on volunteers from rural areas and ethnic minorities aged between 18 and 25 years old. The programme providesopportunity to work as volunteer for twelve months with partner organization in community development, and so they gain knowledge, skills and experience in strengthening their community’s growth and development. To date, over 100 young people have successfully completed this volunteer internship programme. In 2012 HJA then puts in community volunteering programme, support volunteers who havecompleted their placements to develop projects within their communities and others in term of building capacity of marginalized group, particularly ethnic minority, and women—over past ten years, has supported over 100 volunteers working with 30 partners in the Lao PDR and has improved the lives of over 1,000 people living in disadvantaged communities. Since 2014 HJA is registered as Non-Profit Association with the Lao Ministry of Home Affairs. Under HJA’s strategy plan 2017 - 2020, HJA has goal to develop youth to be leader, facilitator, and contribution to community development as well as to build capacity, vision, and mission to achievement and acknowledgement in public under title: “HuamJai Assamak has standard administration, Services and Central capacity building of Youth” and being representative for youth’s rights protection, promotion, and fulfil for all youth in community.
Phan-Thin Social Enterprise is a none profit Organization. It works on community development toward to liveable society where there is justice, wellbeing, and prosperity for all people. Phan-Thin is focusing on contributing to eradication of all form of inequality and injustice in Lao society by developing the capacity and enhancing a participatory framework for disadvantage and minority people and develop the capacity of youth in all CSOs so they will engage in Social, Environment, Economic Development (SEED) by using holistic and interaction approach.
